modes.name: One shared phone

help.goal: Two teams race to find their own secret words from one word clues. Touch the assassin and you lose at once.
steps: One phone taps Become spymasters and holds the secret key.
That spymaster says one clue word plus a number out loud.
Guessers tap the grid words they think match the clue.
Tap the End turn button to stop guessing while ahead.
First team to reveal all of its own words wins.
notes: A neutral or enemy word ends your turn immediately.
Tapping the assassin loses the game on the spot, so guess carefully.
One shared phone: the map device taps the shouted guesses. A phone per team: each taps on its own turn.
